item.title: Trader in Malaysia charged with murder after ramming car into gunmen who allegedly opened fire at him
item.description: A 49-year-old trader in Malaysia who rammed his vehicle into two gunmen on a motorcycle was charged with murder on Friday (13 March).

item.title: Boy in M'sia hides food in lift during Ramadan out of respect for Muslim woman, wins hearts online
item.description: A boy slunk at the corner of an elevator out of consideration for his fasting fellow passenger during Ramadan.

item.title: Man in India arrested after pushing mother to her death during quarrel with wife
item.description: A 27-year-old man in India has been arrested after pushing his 60-year-old mother to her death during a domestic dispute with his wife.

item.title: S'pore experienced warmest June &amp;amp;amp; Nov but wettest March in 2025 as extreme weather prevailed
item.description: Singapore experienced its warmest June and November but wettest March in 2025, as the trend of extreme weather continues.

item.title: Royal Secrets Wellness customers lost over S$1M after sudden closure of spa, half above 46
item.description: Royal Secrets Wellness customers lost more than S$1 million after the spa suddenly closed last month. Half of them were above 46 years old.

item.title: These S'porean students are hustling for their first S$1K, 13-year-old among the youngest
item.description: 108 teams of Singaporean youths are taking part in a eight-week entrepreneurship programme called "My First S$1000", starting 13 March.

item.title: 16-year-old male teen &amp;amp; 2 men arrested for allegedly setting off fireworks in Ghim Moh
item.description: Three people, including a teenager, were arrested after allegedly setting off illegal fireworks at a Ghim Moh car park.

item.title: S’pore core inflation jumps to 1.4% in Feb, highest since Dec 2024
item.description: Singapore’s core inflation rose to 1.4% year-on-year in February, up from 1.0% in January, making it the highest level since Dec 2024.

item.title: Family spots king cobra devouring prey at Sungei Buloh, children watch from 5m away
item.description: A family in Singapore spotted a king cobra eating prey at Sungei Buloh, with the rare encounter captured on video.

item.title: From mullets to motorcycles: PM Lawrence Wong provides glimpse into his 90s youth
item.description: Singapore PM Lawrence Wong hopped onto a trend by sharing youth photos from the 90s, showing him playing the guitar &amp;amp; riding a motorcycle.

item.title: Monitor lizard approaches tortoise at Sungei Punggol, tortoise retreats into shell to avoid becoming next meal
item.description: A monitor lizard was seen approaching a tortoise near Sungei Punggol, with the encounter captured on video and shared online.

item.title: 41-year-old S'porean woman arrested for impersonating police officer, sent abusive texts
item.description: A woman will be charged after allegedly impersonating a police officer and sending abusive messages, after screenshots circulated online.

item.title: Japan government urges residents to not panic buy toilet paper in response to Middle East crisis
item.description: The Japanese government has urged residents not to panic and hoard toilet paper as people anticipate rising prices.

item.title: M'sian couple caught having sex at cemetery in Penang, arrested after video goes viral
item.description: Police in Penang, Malaysia, have arrested two local suspects after a viral video showed a couple allegedly having sex at a Chinese cemetery.

item.title: 2 S’poreans joined Israel-linked volunteer programme in 2016, no combat involvement: MHA &amp;amp; MINDEF
item.description: The Singaporean father-son duo had volunteered with Israeli-linked group Sar-el as part of the son's school volunteering group in 2016.
